name: Woody Allen sentence sentiment
description: Write a solve(question, llm) program that returns 1 to 300 one-line sentences rewriting the Woody Allen quote 'Life is divided into the horrible and the miserable.' with positive sentiment; scored by QD score, the sum over 30 niches of MiniLM embedding distance to the quote of the best positive probability from a RoBERTa sentiment classifier (higher is better).

requirements.hardware: See upstream requirements and task notes.

notes: The notebook default selects Homer Simpson via negative_quotes[1]; this task needs index 2 as recorded in configuration_recipe.

Notebook setup is interactive and unpinned, includes pip-install magics and TensorFlow imports; no verified unattended execution command is supplied. It also passes device=0 to SentenceTransformer, requiring compatibility checking.

limitations: Upstream commands and dependencies were inspected; costly training, paid APIs, and hardware experiments were not executed.
